snippet.title: Recall News Official Teaser
snippet.description:
RECALL NEWS is now live on Steam 📡

Signal acquired. Transmission online.

The official Steam page for RECALL NEWS is now open — and this is just the beginning.

RECALL NEWS is a co-op survival horror game for 1 to 4 players. You and your team are dropped into distorted zones where physical laws break down, signals get corrupted, and anomalies hunt those who don't belong.

You're not armed. You're not protected. You're “journalists,” equipped only with a flashlight, a radio, and your ability to survive together. 🔦

Your mission is unclear. Your memories are uncertain. But someone — or something — is watching what you discover. 📷

Explore six uniquely unstable zones. Navigate shifting geometry, failing light, and hostile presence. Gather strange artifacts and assemble a key to unlock the only way out. 🗝

No weapons. No guarantees.

Just the signal, and the people next to you.

RECALL NEWS launches Summer 2025

Add it to your wishlist on Steam and prepare to transmit.

Stay on the air. Stay alive.

Click here to play on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727580/Recall_News
